title: Queen of Malacca
overview: At The Malacca Strait, a crucial shipping lane between the Malay Peninsula and Sumatra, the rise, rivalries, and power struggles of three formidable women—Rafah, Kartika and Layla—shape their criminal realm.

title: Dompet Ayah Sepatu Ibu
overview: Based on mega best seller novel by JS Khairen. The story follows two working-class teenagers from West Sumatra named Zenna and Asrul who struggle hard to earn money to support their families. They strive to live a decent life so that their children will not have to endure the hardships of the past—living below the poverty line. This novel, written by Khairen, was directly inspired by the lives of her father and mother.
